We are delighted to welcome [Shashika](../team/2026-11-05-ShashikaAbeysekara.qmd) as a new DiMeN PhD student co-supervised with [Dr. Pegine Walrad](https://www.york.ac.uk/biology/research/infection-immunity/pegine-walrad/).

Shashika's project will be to investigate the role and regulation of biomolecular condensates enabling kinetoplastid parasites host adaptation and differentiation !
